The Stage 3 audit now needs GET /api/v1/events/log on production Dispatch. Until production runs a build with this PR, a Stage 3 run's audit answers 404 and fails closed ('production Dispatch could not be read for the audit'); nothing deploys Dispatch automatically yet (INFRA-64).
